readings.commitment: The Stalin Constitution's rights catalog was the world's most generous on paper: work, rest, education, speech, assembly — guarantees enumerated precisely as their negation peaked
readings.delta: Suppression concealed behind enumeration; beneficiary is the regime's external and internal legitimation; victim set is citizens reading the text as protection; extractiveness unconstrained by any listed right

readings.commitment: The 1936 text describes a state the party operated from outside it: soviets, ministries, and courts in the text, the apparatus that commanded them barely mentioned
readings.delta: Suppression of the real command structure from the constitutional page; beneficiary is the party's unaccountable parallel hierarchy; victim set is anyone navigating by the written map; extractiveness exercised through the undescribed channel

readings.commitment: The 1936 text is federal to the letter: union republics with constitutions, borders, and an explicit right of secession no one could survive invoking
readings.delta: Suppression of the named exit absolute in practice; beneficiary is nationality-form presentation; victim set is republics testing the clause; extractiveness of the union enforced beneath a voluntary-union text

readings.commitment: The constitution arrived with the Terror: adopted by acclamation in December 1936 as the purge lists lengthened — the most rights-rich text and the most rightless year, same calendar
readings.delta: Suppression at maximum during the guarantee's debut; beneficiary is the spectacle of socialist legality; victim set is the shot and the sentenced of 1937; extractiveness total under the new text's first edition

readings.commitment: Every freedom came pre-conditioned: speech and assembly guaranteed 'in conformity with the interests of the working people' — the limitation built into the grant's own grammar
readings.delta: Suppression internal to the right's definition; beneficiary is the interpreter of 'the interests'; victim set is any use deemed non-conforming; extractiveness of the freedom retained at the definer's pleasure

readings.commitment: The social guarantees had substance the civil ones lacked: employment, housing, and education were delivered in measurable degree — the catalog read selectively true
readings.delta: Suppression uneven across the catalog (civil void, social partial); beneficiary is welfare recipients of the deliverable rights; victim set is civil-liberty claimants; extractiveness of labor exchanged for delivered minima

readings.commitment: The catalog was written for export: the Popular Front era's proof that socialism out-promised liberal constitutions, quoted abroad while unquotable at home
readings.delta: Suppression of domestic invocation; beneficiary is international propaganda and fellow travelers; victim set is the text's domestic audience; extractiveness of legitimacy harvested abroad

readings.commitment: Article 126 is the keyhole where the real state shows: the party named once, as the 'leading core' of all organizations — one clause carrying the entire actual constitution
readings.delta: Suppression of the duality by near-omission; beneficiary is the core's textual deniability; victim set is constitutional readers seeking the sovereign; extractiveness routed through nine words

readings.commitment: Every state organ had a party shadow: nomenklatura appointments, party groups in every soviet, decisions taken in the committee and ratified in the chamber
readings.delta: Suppression of state autonomy at every level; beneficiary is the apparatus controlling appointments; victim set is the soviets' nominal authority; extractiveness administered through the shadow chain

readings.commitment: The 1936 text inverts constitutionalism's premise: it describes power without constraining it — a constitution in the sense of an anatomy, not a leash
readings.delta: Suppression of the limiting function entirely; beneficiary is power free of its own document; victim set is constitutionalism's defining claim; extractiveness unconstrained by definition

readings.commitment: Article 17's secession right was the deadest letter: advocating its use was counter-revolutionary agitation — the right whose invocation was the crime
readings.delta: Suppression of the clause by criminalizing its assertion; beneficiary is unitary control wearing federal clothes; victim set is national movements citing the text; extractiveness of the union's exits painted on

readings.commitment: The federal forms did real identity work: republics, titular languages, and national cadres institutionalized nationhood even as they contained it — form that outlived the content's master
readings.delta: Suppression of nations within stabilizing forms; beneficiary is titular elites and codified identities; victim set is supranational merger visions; extractiveness of the forms repaid in 1991 when they became exits in fact

readings.commitment: Behind the federal map ran one pipe: all-union ministries, one party, one plan — the federation administered as a unitary command economy with decorative borders
readings.delta: Suppression of republican economic autonomy; beneficiary is the central plan; victim set is republic-level priorities; extractiveness allocated from Moscow regardless of the map

readings.commitment: The constitution legitimated the purge's stage: 'the most democratic in the world' proclaimed while the troikas sentenced by quota — the text as the Terror's alibi
readings.delta: Suppression laundered through celebration; beneficiary is the regime's self-presentation at its worst hour; victim set is the quota-sentenced; extractiveness of life itself proceeding under the new guarantees

readings.commitment: The all-people discussion was participation as theater: millions of meetings, thousands of amendments reported, none structural — mobilized consultation rehearsing assent
readings.delta: Suppression of input behind input's spectacle; beneficiary is the appearance of authorship; victim set is genuine deliberation; extractiveness of participation harvested as endorsement

readings.commitment: Some drafters meant it: Bukharin's hand is in the text, and the catalog can be read as the system's deferred promise — the constitution as what the regime claimed it would someday be
readings.delta: Suppression of the promise's schedule, not its statement; beneficiary is reform communists citing the text later; victim set is the drafters themselves (Bukharin shot in 1938); extractiveness of hope conscripted into the document
